description: Unit tests for Windows trust store functionality in the Chromium project, including trust evaluation, EKU restrictions, and issuer retrieval.

classes.name: TrustStoreWinTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for Windows trust store unit tests, parameterized by support for trusted leaf and local anchor constraints.

methods.name: ParseCertFromFile
methods.description: Helper function to parse a certificate from a file into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: ExpectedTrustForAnchor
methods.description: Returns expected trust level for trust anchors based on test parameters.

methods.name: ExpectedTrustForPeer
methods.description: Returns expected trust level for peer certificates based on test parameters.

methods.name: AddToStore
methods.description: Adds a certificate to a given certificate store.

methods.name: AddToStoreWithEKURestriction
methods.description: Adds a certificate to a store with specific EKU restrictions.

methods.name: CreateTrustStoreWin
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreWin instance for testing.
